claims.text: The number of months to reach the goal matches a month-by-month count, exact to the cent.
The month and year the goal lands follow from the start month you typed.
The monthly amount needed for a chosen month is the smallest whole-cent amount that reaches the goal by then.
Yearly interest is added monthly and rounded half up to the cent each month.
A goal already reached, and a plan that saves nothing, each get a plain true answer.
A goal that takes more than 1,200 months says so instead of guessing.
The by-year table adds up: deposits plus interest plus what you had saved equals the balance.
Messy typing never gives a wrong number, NaN or a crash.
A bad entry gets a calm message in plain words that names the field.
